final:
checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int? =
  post (out == None) == (bigint(a) + bigint(b) > bigint(9223372036854775807) or bigint(a) + bigint(b) < bigint(-9223372036854775807) - bigint(1))
  ex checked_add(1, 2) == 3
  ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) == None
  ex checked_add(-9223372036854775807 - 1, -1) == None
  let max = 9223372036854775807
  let min = -9223372036854775807 - 1
  if b > 0 and a > max - b
    return None
  if b < 0 and a < min - b
    return None
  a + b
